tagline: Joshua trees and steel arches mark a highway across two deserts.
intro: Joshua Forest Scenic Road follows US 93 through Joshua trees at the ecological boundaries of the Mohave and Sonoran deserts. ADOT credits this scenery with earning 54 miles of the highway between Wikieup and Wickenburg scenic-road recognition in 1993. The larger Wickenburg-to-I-40 highway combines divided sections with narrow two-lane stretches undergoing widening.

Its route was contested before it carried the US 93 number. In 1935, Aguila and Wickenburg opposed a proposed extension through Ash Fork; Wickenburg argued that a direct Phoenix-to-Kingman route would save 100 miles. The future southern leg entered the state system as SR 93 in 1946. Between 1942 and 1958, crews rebuilt and reworked the highway for the eventual US 93 extension. The US 93 extension reached US 89 north of Wickenburg in 1965, then continued into Wickenburg in 1992 when US 89 was decommissioned there.

Traveling south from Wikieup, start in the Big Sandy River valley between the Hualapai and Aquarius mountains. US 93 crosses Burro Creek on steel arches and passes Nothing before reaching the Santa Maria River. The road continues toward the SR 71 junction southwest of Congress, with Wickenburg beyond.

moments.title: Burro Creek
moments.text: Two steel arches carry US 93 across Burro Creek, about 400 feet above its intermittent waterway. The crossing lies between Nothing and Wikieup on the highway through this remote rural country. Farther north, beyond Wikieup, US 93 turns to follow the western edge of the Big Sandy River and Knight Creek toward Interstate 40.
moments.notice: Twin steel arches cross an intermittent waterway.

moments.title: Nothing
moments.text: Nothing was a settlement of four people at its height, with a gas station and a small convenience store. Richard “Buddy” Kenworthy established it in 1977, 23 miles south of Wikieup on US 93. He left by May 2005, and the settlement was abandoned. A later owner, Mike Jensen, tried a revival, opening a pizza business from a portable oven by April 2009. By April 2011, Nothing was marked as abandoned again. ADOT installed a motorist call box at Nothing, one of four on US 93.

moments.title: Joshua forest
moments.text: Joshua trees mark the southern US 93 landscape where the Mohave and Sonoran deserts meet. In 1993, 54 miles between Wikieup and Wickenburg received recognition as the Joshua Forest Scenic Road for their unusual scenery.
